summary: Exited on the regime-change signature: 1m z_se dropped to -2.67 (statistically extended against the position) while reversion_prob_30 simultaneously crashed from its ~0.97-0.99 baseline (seen through 8+ prior chop cycles that all recovered) down to 0.54, plus a sharp -8.75pt single 1m bar. That combination -- extension without the usual mean-reversion expectation -- read as structurally different from the earlier -10 to -14pt giveback swings that repeatedly bounced back, where reversion_prob stayed high throughout. Next time I'd want to watch whether reversion_prob crash is a reliable discriminator versus just noise in a thin sample, and pay closer attention to whether price makes a genuine lower-low breakdown versus staying within the established chop range before pulling the trigger.
